correctness.rationale: Classify six-point affine sets by rank 3, 4 with 4-relation, 4 with 6-relation, and rank 5; over F2 these are exactly four affine-equivalence types. For pair-sum counts q(t), the energies Q=36+4 sum q(t)^2 are 168,120,96,96; character orthogonality yields second and fourth Walsh moments, while the only magnitude-6 character in the affine span is trivial. Solving the exact linear moment system gives local histograms (4,3,0,1),(6,7,2,1),(0,15,0,1),(10,15,6,1), with ambient lift 2^(d-r), and distinct support fractions. Independent exhaustive Walsh enumeration covered every 28 six-subsets of F2^3 and every 8008 six-subsets of F2^4 and canonical rank-5 set. All dimensions follow from affine linear algebra, not finite testing.
